conventions: See rust/ARCHITECTURE.md. rust_files ending in '/' own the whole directory. Packages in the same wave own disjoint files; a package may also ADD new private submodules under a directory it owns. lib.rs/mod.rs module declarations were pre-written by the architect; a package may only edit the lib.rs/mod.rs it owns. Shared types in fm-core are frozen. Each package ports the intent of its python_tests_to_port as Rust unit/integration tests in its own test file.

packages.title: Parity test harness: fixture loaders, JSON comparator, normalizers, runners
parity_tests: fm-parity self tests (compare a fixture with itself, perturbations are caught)
packages.notes: Implement the signatures the architect left in fm-parity/src (lib.rs, fixtures.rs, compare.rs, normalize.rs, bin/parity-diff.rs; extend, don't break - later packages code against them). API: Fixtures::league(name) -> snapshot (fm_core::Snapshot), values (re-attach `player` from ctx by cid: values.json/dynasty.json store `cid`), dynasty, picks, engine(name) -> Value, cli(name) -> Value, tape path. compare(expected, actual, &Tolerance) -> Vec<Diff> with: numbers abs/rel tolerance (default 1e-9 rel, 1e-9 abs), configurable per-path overrides (glob-like `$.output.win_*`), `unordered` paths (compare arrays as multisets / objects ignoring key order - needed for PlayerValue.rates, lineup no_slot lists), `ignore` paths, and string normalizers (regex replace, e.g. timestamps). A failing comparison must print the first N diffs with paths and write the full diff to rust/parity/out/<test>.txt. Fixture root: env FM_PARITY_FIXTURES or rust/parity/fixtures; tapes/harness.db are gitignored - helpers must make 'absent' an explicit skip (return None / print a SKIP line), never a failure. Provide `assert_parity!(expected, actual, tol)`. Also add a `bin` target `parity-diff` (fm-parity/src/bin/parity-diff.rs) that diffs two JSON files with the same rules (handy for CLI parity).

parity_tests: for each page and league: GET with the snapshot-backed loader, normalize whitespace, compare with the Python page rendered by FastAPI TestClient on the same snapshot (add your own rust/parity/dump_<area>.py that imports dump_fixtures helpers (never edit dump_fixtures.py))

Python-isms to support in minijinja: `'%.2f'|format(x)` (custom format filter via fm_pycompat::fmt::percent_format), `.strftime(fmt)` / `.isoformat()` / `.get(k, d)` / `.items()` / `.values()` / `.startswith()` / `.strip()` / `.replace()` via Environment::set_unknown_method_callback, `|truncate` (minijinja-contrib), `loop.previtem/nextitem`, `is defined` on attributes, None/True printing as Python reprs (custom formatter), float printing via repr_f64. `{% set _ = sweet.append(x) %}` in recommendations.html mutates a list: preprocess template source at load time (string rewrite to a namespace pattern) inside templates.rs - never edit the .html files. Caching: PipelineLoader (600 s) + ResultCache per league with per-league locks; heavy work in spawn_blocking. Static files via tower-http ServeDir from fantasy_manager/web/static.
